# Kaamkar

Kaamkar (https://www.kaamkar.com) is a job board for Pakistan and the Gulf: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and Bahrain.

Job seekers can search roles, build a CV, set alerts and apply. Employers can post jobs, search CVs and shortlist applicants.

Main pages:
- https://www.kaamkar.com/jobs
- https://www.kaamkar.com/locations/lahore
- https://www.kaamkar.com/locations/karachi
- https://www.kaamkar.com/locations/islamabad
- https://www.kaamkar.com/locations/dubai
- https://www.kaamkar.com/cv
- https://www.kaamkar.com/hire
- https://www.kaamkar.com/companies
- https://www.kaamkar.com/guides
- https://www.kaamkar.com/links

Contact: Islamabad, Pakistan. Email: hello@kaamkar.com
